risk_target: R1 (Atomistic sp3d5s* R331 closure & Pareto-optimal 29Si isotope fraction f* for M4 percolation)
question: Does a real-space atomistic 10-band sp3d5s* Boykin-Klimeck (2004) tight-binding 31P donor solver (solved via exact FFT-preconditioned shift-invert Lanczos on periodic FCC silicon supercells up to 16,000 atoms / 160,000 orbitals with Morton-Preston atomic contact density and bounded p/d core polarization) resolve the Exp129 VOKL-6 R331 ENDOR shell discrepancy (64.73% error) without fitting 29Si shells, and what is the Pareto-optimal 29Si isotope fraction f* and electric field E_z for Mode B K=8 yield, M4 L=11 FT percolation (N_cand=6 >= 99.5%), and coherence T2e / T2n*?

fixed_parameters.tb_model: Boykin, Klimeck, Oyafuso PRB 69, 115201 (2004) Silicon sp3d5s*

non_diamond_coordinate_audit.(3,3,0): Invalid diamond site (mixed odd/even coordinates in a0/4 units); documented explicitly
non_diamond_coordinate_audit.(1,1,3): Not on sublattice B (sum=5 mod 4 != 3); valid tetrahedral partner is (1,1,-3) (sum=-1 mod 4 == 3)

predictions.description: Boykin-Klimeck (2004) Si sp3d5s* bulk Bloch Hamiltonian reproduces indirect bandgap E_g in [1.10, 1.20] eV, valley minimum k_min in [0.80, 0.86] (2pi/a0), m_t in [0.17, 0.22] m0, m_l in [0.85, 1.00] m0, VBM spin-orbit Delta_0 in [0.038, 0.050] eV, and FFT-vs-sparse CSR matrix equivalence < 1e-12.

Real-space atomistic sp3d5s* supercell (N>=16, >=8,192 atoms / >=81,920 orbitals) calibrated exclusively to 31P invariants matches E(1s A1)=-45.59 +/- 0.15 meV, Delta_VO(T2-A1)=11.70 +/- 0.15 meV, Delta_VO(E-A1)=13.01 +/- 0.15 meV, A_P(0)=117.53 +/- 1.0 MHz, Td multiplet spreads < 1e-3 meV, and finite-size shift |E_A1(N=16)-E_A1(N=20)| <= 1.5 meV.

Out-of-sample atomistic sp3d5s* hyperfine model (direct |c_s|^2 and physically bounded p/d core polarization alpha_cp <= 0.10, zero 29Si shell fitting) reduces (3,3,1) relative error strictly below both Exp129 VOKL-6 (64.73%) and legacy KL (49.05%) to <= 30.0%.

Across the 4 audited shells {(1,1,1), (3,3,1), (2,2,0), (1,1,-3)}, atomistic sp3d5s* achieves strictly lower log10-RMS error than Exp129 VOKL-6 (0.7445) and legacy KL (0.5736), and ab-initio a(0,0,4) lies within 35% of Hale & Mieher 5.962 MHz.

Direct atomistic sp3d5s* electric-field sweep E_z in [0, 3.0] MV/m yields a negative quadratic 31P hyperfine Stark coefficient eta_A in [-3.0e-2, -1.0e-3] um^2/V^2 (Bradbury 2006 / Rahman 2007 range) and quantifies Mode B P_yield(f, E_z) response.

Across f in {0.5, 1.0, 1.25, 1.5, 1.75, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0}% (N_cell=400) under the atomistic sp3d5s* Hale-Mieher atlas, Mode B K=8 yield increases monotonically across [0.5%, 2.0%] and achieves M4 L=11 FT (<=5% dead) percolation >= 99.5% at N_cand=6 for some f <= 2.5%.

Strict Pareto test at f*: simultaneous M4 L=11 FT percolation >= 99.5% (N_cand=6) AND raw Hahn-echo T2e(f*) >= 10 ms. Honest physical expectation: raw Hahn-echo T2e at f >= 0.5% is < 10 ms (0.3-2.3 ms), so raw Hahn fails while XY8/CPMG DD (N=32-64) is quantified separately.

success_rule: TB1, TB2, TB3, TB4, TB5, TB6 PASS (atomistic sp3d5s* closes R1 and finds M4 Pareto f*); TB7 is evaluated strictly and honestly without post-hoc threshold edits.
